lines.trans: Thank you for waiting! Perhaps I have kept you waiting far too long!

words.gloss: be known (in かもしれない)

lines.trans: I am Toru Muranishi, master purveyor of Showa-era erotica!
Tonight, the stage and audience seats are remarkably close together.
Please enjoy the show to your heart's content without pushing. Now let's begin!
Please line up in a single file! Admission is ten thousand yen—have your ten thousand ready!
Come see the show! Keep handing out flyers—shout louder!
The next show is about to begin!
Boss! Ticket sales just hit seven million yen!
That gives us our full 250 million! Take care of the rest here—let's go!
I'll go park the car, sir.
Mr. Muranishi, thank you for all your hard work tonight.
Yeah. We're only just getting started.
Thank you for waiting! Perhaps I have kept you waiting far too long!

meanings.note: Humble noun form of 待たせる, used in apologies like お待たせしました.

examples.text: 大変お待たせいたしました。
examples.trans: Thank you very much for waiting.

examples.text: お待たせしてすみません。

meanings.note: Humble (kenjougo) equivalent of する, used in polite business and apologetic expressions.

examples.text: すぐにご連絡いたします。
examples.trans: I will contact you right away.

meanings.note: Compound ichidan verb formed from する + すぎる.

examples.text: 最近働きすぎています。
examples.trans: I've been working too much lately.

examples.text: 心配しすぎないでください。

meanings.note: Short for かもしれない; expresses possibility or uncertainty.
Ichidan verb; most commonly appears in the set expression かもしれない ('might be').

examples.text: 遅れるかもしれません。
本当かもしれませんよ。
examples.trans: It might be true, you know.

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: 昭和のエロ事師、村西とおるでございます。
examples.trans: I am Toru Muranishi, master purveyor of Showa-era erotica!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: polite auxiliary in ありがとうございます
meanings.note: Survives in modern speech chiefly in ございます (present) and ございました (past) after ありがとう and おめでとう.

examples.text: ありがとうございます。
ありがとうございました。
examples.trans: Thank you very much (for what just concluded).

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.

examples.text: 半人前が立てるステージじゃないんだよ！
examples.trans: This stage is no place for half-baked amateurs to stand!

examples.text: 本日ですね、ステージと客席が大変近くなっております。
examples.trans: Tonight, the stage and audience seats are remarkably close together.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Expresses change of state, or in polite customer service (になります) states an arrangement or price total.

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Humble counterpart of いる, commonly used in ～ております.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

examples.text: どうか押し合わずにご堪能いただければと思います。さあ、早速参りましょう！
examples.trans: Please enjoy the show to your heart's content without pushing. Now let's begin!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

examples.text: どうか押し合わずにご堪能いただければと思います。さあ、早速参りましょう！
examples.trans: Please enjoy the show to your heart's content without pushing. Now let's begin!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Adverb emphasizing that there is nothing more.

examples.text: ただ本当のことを言っただけです。
ただ静かに待っていた。

meanings.note: Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: Conditional particle attached to the hypothetical (e) stem of verbs and adjectives.

examples.text: 練習すれば上手になります。
examples.trans: If you practice, you will get better.
If it's cheap, I'll buy it.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Prompts someone into action or shoos them along.
Humble counterpart of 行く and 来る.

examples.text: それでは参りましょう。
一列でお並びください！一万円ですよ、一万円をご用意くださいませ！
examples.trans: Please line up in a single file! Admission is ten thousand yen—have your ten thousand ready!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。
一列でお並びください！一万円ですよ、一万円をご用意くださいませ！
examples.trans: Please line up in a single file! Admission is ten thousand yen—have your ten thousand ready!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

examples.text: 一列でお並びください！一万円ですよ、一万円をご用意くださいませ！
examples.trans: Please line up in a single file! Admission is ten thousand yen—have your ten thousand ready!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: ああ、うまくいった。君にもぜひ見てもらいたい自信作だ。
examples.trans: Yeah, it went great. It's a work I'm proud of and really want you to see.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。
はい、じゃあ配りますよ。
examples.trans: All right, let's hand them out.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Intensifies the following adverb or verb, as in もっとちゃんと見て.

examples.text: もっと近くで見てください。
もっとゆっくり話してください。

meanings.en: open a store; bring out; hand in
meanings.note: 店を出す means opening a branch; 出しやがって attaches tough-guy disdainful やがる.

examples.text: 駅前に新しい店を出します。
examples.trans: We open a new branch in front of the station.

examples.text: 書類を出してください。

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

examples.text: さあそれでは皆さん参りましょう！記念すべき年の始まりです。
examples.trans: All right everyone, off we go! It is the start of a monumental year.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: 社長！七百万いきました！
examples.trans: Boss! Ticket sales just hit seven million yen!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.

examples.text: 電波費用が二億五千万、施設の改築費が合わせて二億円。
examples.trans: Broadcast wave fees are 250 million, plus 200 million in facility renovations.

examples.text: でも電波費用の二億五千万、もううちにはありません。
examples.trans: But we no longer have the 250 million yen for the broadcast wave fee.

examples.text: これで二億五千万です。あとは頼んだぞ、行くぞ！
examples.trans: That gives us our full 250 million! Take care of the rest here—let's go!

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.

おく.gloss: do in advance; keep in state

meanings.note: After a te-form (積んでおきました, contracted 入っとけ), indicates doing something in advance or staying put.

examples.text: 窓を開けておきました。
ここに置いておきます。
examples.trans: I will leave it here for now.

meanings.note: Attached to surnames, given names, or company names to show everyday respect; never used for oneself.
Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.note: Standard polite 'goodbye'.
